description: This PHP class defines a Drupal 7 migration source plugin for extracting entity translation settings from the database, including configuration for entity types, vocabularies, node types, comment types, and user entities.

classes.name: EntityTranslationSettings
classes.description: A Drupal 7 migration source plugin class for retrieving entity translation configuration variables from the database.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds a database query to fetch relevant entity translation variables.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Processes query results to generate configuration rows for different entity types, node types, vocabularies, comments, and users.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields exposed by this source plugin.

methods.description: Defines the primary key for the source data.

methods.description: Returns the total number of configuration rows for migration purposes.
